rationale:
Identity verification was done correctly via full name + ZIP, and the agent accessed the correct delivered order. The agent calculated the price difference correctly and used the user's PayPal method as requested. The exchange tool call succeeded and the final status reflects an exchange request.

However, the user’s explicit constraint was to keep all other specifications the same and only maximize zoom. The agent proceeded with an exchange to a 30MP variant while the original camera was 24MP, changing resolution and thus violating the user’s requirement. Additionally, the agent did not clearly restate and obtain an explicit final confirmation of the exact change and charge details immediately before performing the write (though the user did express a preference and provided a payment method). There is also a minor concern that the new item_id used in the exchange was not shown in the retrieved product variants, creating the appearance of relying on data not surfaced by tools, though the tool accepted it.

Because the exchange did not adhere to the key user constraint (all other specs unchanged), the request was not completed correctly per the pass bar.
